scripts.build: npm run merge && npm run link-registry && node copy-static.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply eatouts --local
scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply eatouts --remote
scripts.db:seed: python scripts/build_d1_seed.py && node scripts/build_link_registry.mjs && npx wrangler d1 execute eatouts --file scripts/seeds/restaurants.sql --remote && npx wrangler d1 execute eatouts --file scripts/seeds/business_links.sql --remote
scripts.pages:dev: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist
